scope: Final verification of the 63 review decisions for the Swift QtSpim port. All accepted items are addressed within the documented test scope. These finite checks do not establish exhaustive equivalence. Publication is managed by the project owner.

Final release Hello World stopped at main, single-stepped to PC 0x00400028 with v0=4, then F5 printed Hello World and exited 0. Controller regression verifies repeat-Run vs step-ending restart. Qt state transition rationale retained in decisions.
Final rebuilt native Data pane showed compact aligned 15-point single-line rows in a split; controller/export tests verify live memory words, read-only device inspection and compressed zero ranges.

Final release in the small docked console completed tt.core after six submitted inputs, exited 0 and visibly showed Testing SLEU, Testing SNE and Passed all tests without redocking or resizing. Apple Silicon hosted-window regression verifies the pass marker inside both the actual 89-point viewport and its 150-point host. A separate native test checks all 100,000 lines, UTF-8 repair, visible tail and clearing.
testEffectiveConsoleModeAndSourceFailureVisibility verifies hidden newline cannot affect ordinary syscall input. Final release tt.core finished after all six input submissions.
Revised §12 describes virtual descriptors, binary streams, mapped-range validation and removal of the fixed transfer limit. Post-review comparisons include closed stdin and binary stderr.
testMemoryAndTextLogIncludeZeroRangesAndRuntimeInstructions verifies runtime-written instruction visibility and source metadata. Shared export path exercised by previous native log and PDF smoke.

Final 54 native tests and release build, 29 focused comparisons, seven fixtures, 4,758 words, four layouts, bounded timer and six-line GUI core run passed. Relocation and print/log paths had prior native coverage. Native pointer/tail checks completed under the linked docking and console records.
Independent post-fix native compare: all seven upstream fixture streams/statuses and all 4,758 tt.core instruction words match. AssemblerRecovery and forward-fixup tests pass.

Prior real-app screenshot/AX comparison and native all-panel log/102-page PDF, plus current regression on live disassembly, zero ranges and text writes. Exact visual/typographic identity and exhaustive FP formatting were not claimed.

Controlled r764 read.s and bounded time.s exact. Bounded timer.s exits on Count=15 or first handler; mapped mode prints one interrupt message on both CLIs, unmapped mode produces none on either CLI. Both statuses 0 and stderr empty. testRunSamplesPendingInterruptAtQtBatchBoundaries verifies GUI software IRQ delivery at the 100,000-instruction boundary.
Native big-endian oracle unavailable. The rebuilt debug CLI running tt.be with --big-endian exits 0 with Passed all tests and empty stderr. Core endian unit tests pass.

Final native split placement survived relaunch; independent native testLaunchAndDockPreferencesRoundTrip covers saved groups and injected options. Historical GUI final release persistence checks also covered simulator prefs. Unrestricted FIFO main-thread behavior was not separately stress-tested.

Tests/SpimCoreTests/ReviewRegressionTests.swift and Tests/SwiftSpimTests/DebuggerTests.swift cover semantic recovery, scoped symbols, input breakpoints, incremental state, IRQ, source bytes, guest streams and stack. Controlled command-line comparisons additionally cover service 12 NUL, closed fd0, post-disable banner and mapped/unmapped timer.
GUI keeps distinct file list, CLI -file documents guest arguments; neither adopts unrelated upstream persistence-key errors.

Final release native pointer: dragged Data tab to bottom to split, onto Text header to retab, register divider to resize, and Data header to x=1280 outside the 1240-point workspace to float. Floating Data Segments Inspector exposed Dock Again. Dock Again Console and Arrange menu split also verified. Split persisted after restart.
